prompt.overview: Look into how {{application}} ({{environment}}) did from {{from}} to {{to}}: start with the overview and the newest issues, say what is out of the ordinary, find the likely cause and give the next step.
prompt.errors: Look into the errors of {{application}} ({{environment}}) from {{from}} to {{to}}: which issues touch the most sessions, which are new or came back and since which version, the likely causes and what to do first.
prompt.performance: Look into how fast the pages of {{application}} ({{environment}}) were from {{from}} to {{to}}: the Core Web Vitals and how they are rated, which pages, versions and browsers hold them back, what the slowest views waited for, and what to fix first.
prompt.vital: Look into the {{vital}} of {{application}} ({{environment}}) from {{from}} to {{to}}: how it is rated, which pages, versions and browsers hold it back, what the slowest views waited for, and what to fix first.
prompt.frustration: Look into what frustrates the users of {{application}} ({{environment}}) from {{from}} to {{to}}: which elements, pages and versions show rage, dead or error clicks, what happens when they click, and the likely cause.
prompt.issue: Investigate the issue “{{error}}” (id {{issue}}) of {{application}} ({{environment}}) from {{from}} to {{to}}: how many sessions and people it touches, since when and since which version, whether it came back, the likely cause from its stack and sessions, and what to do next.
prompt.slice: Look into the views of {{application}} ({{environment}}) whose {{dimension}} is {{value}} from {{from}} to {{to}}: how they do, what is slow or failing, the likely cause and the next step.
prompt.slice_figure: Look into the views of {{application}} ({{environment}}) whose {{dimension}} is {{value}} from {{from}} to {{to}}; their {{vital}} 75th percentile is {{figure}}. What holds it back, which versions and browsers carry it, what the slowest views waited for, and what to fix first.
prompt.element: Look into the element “{{element}}” of {{application}} ({{environment}}) from {{from}} to {{to}}: users show rage, dead or error clicks on it. What happens when they click, on which pages and versions, and the likely cause.
prompt.element_selector: Look into the element “{{element}}” ({{selector}}) of {{application}} ({{environment}}) from {{from}} to {{to}}: users show rage, dead or error clicks on it. What happens when they click, on which pages and versions, and the likely cause.
prompt.session: Look into the session {{session}} of {{application}} ({{environment}}), which ran from {{from}} to {{to}}: what the person did in order, what went wrong, and the likely cause.
prompt.incident: Investigate the alert “{{summary}}” of {{application}} ({{environment}}) from {{from}} to {{to}}: what made the figure move, which pages, versions and browsers carry it, the likely cause and the next step. List the plan first, then give the evidence point by point; make no production changes.
prompt.incident_sessions: Investigate the alert “{{summary}}” of {{application}} ({{environment}}) from {{from}} to {{to}}: what made the figure move, which pages, versions and browsers carry it, the likely cause and the next step. The alert was told by these sessions: {{sessions}}. List the plan first, then give the evidence point by point; make no production changes.
